basis: Skill-family equivalence, not identical questions, contexts, numerical results or difficulty. Representative local tasks cover each published topic within its source family. Different reduced database samples remain explicitly labelled.
limits: SQL and workbook execution/feedback are local; no embedded AI service.
The restaurant model outputs are fitted to course data; the teacher regression contexts use synthetic teaching values.
Monthly P-card samples and the Movies subset are not full-population data.
Topic coverage does not establish equal exam difficulty or measured learning outcomes.
